questions.question: Phuong trinh mat cau dang chuan trong khong gian Oxyz la gi, va tam ban kinh duoc xac dinh nhu the nao?
questions.expectedOutput: Phuong trinh mat cau dang chuan co dang (x - a)^2 + (y - b)^2 + (z - c)^2 = R^2, trong do tam la I(a, b, c) va ban kinh la R.

questions.question: Khi viet phuong trinh mat cau dang tong quat, dieu kien nao de phuong trinh thuc su la mot mat cau?
questions.expectedOutput: Voi dang x^2 + y^2 + z^2 + 2ax + 2by + 2cz + d = 0, tam la (-a, -b, -c), ban kinh la sqrt(a^2 + b^2 + c^2 - d), va dieu kien la a^2 + b^2 + c^2 - d > 0.

questions.question: Neu biet tam mat cau va mot diem nam tren mat cau thi lap phuong trinh mat cau theo cac buoc nao?
questions.expectedOutput: Tinh ban kinh bang khoang cach tu tam den diem nam tren mat cau, sau do thay toa do tam va R^2 vao dang (x - a)^2 + (y - b)^2 + (z - c)^2 = R^2.

questions.question: Video nay co trinh bay cach tinh tich phan tung phan khong?
questions.expectedOutput: Khong co du bang chung trong transcript de tra loi cau hoi nay.
